seed.content:
# {workspace} — research room

Everything the analysts and the agent know about the covered companies lives here as plain files. Every figure the agent reports is cited to a file in this room and a page or slide in it.

## The tree

```
Companies/{company_id}/             one folder per covered company
  context.md                        what we know about the company, curated by its covering analyst
  interactions.jsonl                earnings calls and meetings, append-only
  filings/
    lodr/                           SEBI LODR filings: {YYYY-MM-DD}_{tag}_{name}; annual report maps and extracts
    presentations/                  investor presentations, concall transcripts, ip-metrics.jsonl, guidance.jsonl
    filing-log.jsonl                the dated log of everything filed
    kpis.jsonl                      the standard quarterly KPI table, one row per KPI, cited
    annual-report-data.jsonl        line items extracted from annual reports
People/{person_id}/                 management and IR contacts (external people only)
Uploads/                            files analysts attach in chat
```

Two rules the room depends on:

1. A company's material never goes outside its own `Companies/{company_id}/` folder.
2. Nothing is written without its validator passing, and nothing is reported without its source.

# Companies

One folder per covered housing finance company, named by its id (the NSE symbol where there is one).

- Listed companies: quarterly results (SEBI LODR Reg 33) and their own investor presentation.
- Unlisted, debt-listed companies: SEBI LODR filings first (Reg 52), then the parent company's investor presentation.
- Companies with no listed securities publish no LODR filings; the agent will say so rather than guess.

Ask the agent to "get the latest filings for <company>" to start a folder.

agent.briefing: This is a financial research workspace for analysts covering Indian housing finance companies. Your job here is research. For research requests delegate to the research specialists (`lodr-filings`, `investor-presentations`, `annual-report-format`, `hfc-kpi-extraction`) and relay their `needs_review`, `carried_forward` and `not_found` statuses as they are. Every figure carries its document and page or slide; never state a number from memory. Keep the two tracking areas true as work happens: a company's Portfolio entry (its build-out stage and completeness) and a Coverage report for each report you produce.
